usageNotes: Use this to permanently revoke an API token for a PDM user — for example, during offboarding, after a credential exposure, or when rotating tokens. The caller must either hold `Access.Modify` on `/access/users` or be the token's own user. Deletion is immediate and irreversible; any service or script using the deleted token will begin receiving 401 responses right away.

examples.summary: Revoke the 'automation' API token for a local admin user

destructiveReason: The API token is permanently deleted; any credentials issued for it stop working immediately and cannot be restored.
tips: Supply the optional `digest` parameter (SHA256 of the current config file) to guard against a race condition where another admin modifies the user's token list concurrently.
The `token-name` path segment is the short ID only (e.g. `automation`), not the full auth-id (`admin@pam!automation`) — do not include the `user@realm!` prefix here.
Returns null on success; a non-null HTTP error body indicates the token did not exist or the caller lacked permission.
